name: Modified 4th Order Runge-Kutta Integration
definition: A numerical integration method used for the deformation process, based on the 4th order Runge-Kutta method, adapted to treat position adjustment as equal to the force field at the same time step.
summary: Modified 4th Order Runge-Kutta Integration accelerates volume deformation by relaxing intermediate accuracy to find spring model equilibrium states faster than standard RK4.
